Retained full source license documents accompany this source-only packet under licenses/.
Their original bytes and retrieval hashes are not replaced with a paraphrase. No upstream
browser implementation, library, assets or vendor code is imported into the product.
The native algorithm normalizes square-sampled gradients and retries zero vectors.
Native sampling uses physical pixel centers; browser phase, gradient precision and
intermediate color conversion can produce different pixels. Universal byte identity
is not claimed. This notice is not a conformance or completed legal review.
